ns2:section.sectionText: JOUR 199 Getting started in Journalism (3 hours) Get a head start on your journalism classes with a special preview of such topics as finding interesting stories, gathering and organizing information, writing in journalistic forms and using major technological tools to present your work. This special early look at topics to be covered in greater detail in later classes will help prepare you for those classes and for such other activities as participating in student media. Designed exclusively for incoming journalism majors not immediately eligible to enroll in JOUR 200.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Journalism major(s). Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
